items.title: Understanding your dog's stress bucket
items.summary: Dr Sarah Heath's bath tub analogy — why everyday stresses stack up, why a calm dog can suddenly stop coping, and how rest lets the bucket drain. A one-page printable leaflet.

items.title: The sensitive dog
items.summary: What a sensitive dog is, how dogs communicate through body language, the Ladder of Aggression, and trigger stacking — with practical ways to help. A two-page printable leaflet.

items.title: Reading your dog's body language
items.summary: Kendal Shepherd's Ladder of Aggression explained — the quiet signals dogs give before they have to shout, how to read eyes, ears, mouth, tail and body, why a freeze and stare needs extra care, and what to do when you see the signals. A two-page printable leaflet.

items.title: Free Work
items.summary: An introduction to Free Work, part of Sarah Fisher's ACE (Animal Centred Education) — letting your dog sniff, explore and choose while you quietly watch, what it can tell you, and how to set up a simple, safe session at home. A two-page printable leaflet.

items.title: Setting your dog up for walking success
items.summary: Choosing and fitting a shoulder-friendly harness and lead, why dogs pull (and why huskies are bred to), and how to plan calmer walks — before you go, while you're out and when you get home. A two-page printable leaflet.

items.title: Calmer grooming
items.summary: Inspired by Sue Williamson's Taking the Grrr out of Grooming — building trust before the task, the consent check, where on the body to start, setting up at home, and choosing a low-stress groomer. A two-page printable leaflet.

items.title: Helping your dog switch off
items.summary: The body's "accelerator" and "brake", what the vagus nerve does, signs your dog is relaxing, and calm, natural ways to help them rest — sniffing, licking, slow touch, sleep and your own calm. A two-page printable leaflet.

items.title: Basic scentwork for every dog
items.summary: Based on Dr Rob Hewings' Scent Training for Every Dog — why scentwork helps, handler tips, reading your dog, why it suits nervous dogs, and a five-day starter plan for home. A two-page printable leaflet.

items.title: Scentwork level 2: bigger searches
items.summary: The next step after basic scentwork. Using scent pipes, take the search into a whole room, up high and low, through two rooms and out into the garden, with a simple rule for when to move on. Also covers decompression days in a secure field or around the car. A three-page printable guide with a progress log.

items.title: The den and the C-shape
items.summary: What wolf families teach us about helping a nervous dog feel safe: inside a wolf den, why the "alpha" idea is out of date, giving your dog a den of their own, making a C-shape to bond, walking in curves, and staying calm so your dog can settle with you. A two-page printable leaflet.
